data.title: 德尔塔 · 暖炉绒毯的卷尾酣梦
data.description: 暗影神殿偏殿的壁炉前。炭火噼啪作响。德尔塔整个人像只大犬般蜷缩在厚厚的羊毛绒毯中央，把巨大的黑色狼尾当成抱枕紧紧抱在怀里，嘴角流下一丝晶莹的口水，嘴里还含糊咕哝着“老大的味道……好吃……”。
data.location: grand hearthstone hearth rug in a dimly lit gothic stone den with crackling fire
data.action: curled into a ball on a thick fur rug, hugging her own massive fluffy tail like a bolster pillow, peaceful sleeping smile
data.lighting: rich warm amber embers and flickering hearth fire casting dancing red glows
data.mood: total peaceful bliss, safe home comfort, heartwarming beast devotion
data.promptProse: Delta curls into a sleeping ball on a warm fireplace rug in a furry hoodie, tightly hugging her fluffy tail like a plush toy.
data.animaCaption: Delta fast asleep by the crackling fireplace hugging her giant fluffy tail.
